captions.story: Deep beneath the Atlantic lies an abyss deeper than Mount Everest is tall. What is hidden inside the Milwaukee Deep?

story.series: What Lies at the Bottom of the Puerto Rico Trench?
story.summary: Explored the Milwaukee Deep inside the Puerto Rico Trench, the deepest point in the Atlantic Ocean. Revealed its crushing pressure, alien bioluminescent creatures, and the tectonic fault lines capable of causing massive tsunamis.

title: What Lies at the Bottom of the Puerto Rico Trench?
